description: V8's Math functions (Node at tools/goldens/.node-version, arm64): Math[fn](...args) = result, every double as its IEEE 754 bits in hex, a NaN result as the string NaN. sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, atan2, exp, log, log2, log10 and cbrt are V8's fdlibm (src/base/ieee754.cc, fused multiply-adds on arm64); hypot is src/builtins/math.tq; pow only where its answer does not depend on the platform's pow (tools/goldens/js-math.mjs).
